newsitem.title: MEXICO: La Moderna may raise cigarette prices 12-15 pct.
newsitem.headline: La Moderna may raise cigarette prices 12-15 pct.

text.p: La Moderna, Mexico's tobacco and vegetable-seed giant, will raise cigarette prices between 12 percent and 15 percent as of Saturday, the government news agency Notimex reported Wednesday.
A company spokeswoman could not confirm the price increases to Reuters late Wednesday.

In a report from Merida in the state of Yucatan, Notimex cited Jose Fernandez Diez, a regional director for La Moderna, as saying the price increase was due to the company's outlook for the cigarette industry in 1997 and the company's estimated earnings.
La Moderna produces many of the major Mexican cigarette brands.
